reason: Reading Time is embedded in a large shared footer runtime rather than an isolated script.
The runtime also contains unrelated header and page behavior.
The feature reads window.civilEngineerSetting through shared helper functions.
The feature exposes and uses global callbacks and DOM selectors.
Removing only the Reading Time portion could change execution order or break shared dependencies.
requiredRefactorBeforeCdn: Extract shared configuration access into a stable adapter.
Define an explicit page-data contract for reading-time markers and article URLs.
Separate Reading Time functions from the shared footer runtime.
Preserve the Blogger inline bootstrap and configuration.
Run syntax, selector, and Blogger runtime tests before replacing inline code.

cdnDecision.nextSafeCandidate: A genuinely isolated static utility, after dependency review
